src/identity-proxy.ts.name: Identity requests
src/identity-proxy.ts.description: Passes a napplet's identity requests to the runtime; sending to the napplet directly is refused in favour of the bridge.

src/keys-proxy.ts.name: Key shortcut requests
src/keys-proxy.ts.description: Passes a napplet's keys requests to the runtime and sends key messages back to it over its channel.

src/media-proxy.ts.name: Media requests
src/media-proxy.ts.description: Passes a napplet's media requests to the runtime and sends media messages back to it over its channel.

src/notify-proxy.ts.name: Notification requests
src/notify-proxy.ts.description: Passes a napplet's notification requests to the runtime and sends notification messages back over its channel.

src/theme-proxy.ts.name: Theme requests
src/theme-proxy.ts.description: Passes a napplet's theme requests to the runtime; sending themes directly is refused in favour of the bridge.
